title: FCH micelles from noise keep a self-made cargo through fission: every daughter holds it at 7-1000x the outside (SIWD, fch-bilayer)
summary: The fch-protocell world moved to the micelle-fission regime (eta1=4, eta2=5, uniform amphiphile feed 5e-4) with the solute coupling reversed (chi=-3): the cargo c is made where amphiphile is dense, decays slowly (kd=0.002) and partitions into the amphiphile-rich micelle cores (Scharfetter-Gummel flux in the potential chi u). From white noise ~30 micelles form by t~16; they grow on the feed, elongate into dumbbells and split, 18-26 persistent splits per seed, generation 2-3, 0-1 merges. Every body holds the cargo at >= 7x the outside at every frame (aggregate 760-1430x), and both daughters of each fission keep it (fission_strips_*.png: a parent at ~1150x splits into two daughters at ~400x each). With chi=0 (same bodies, the u field is bit-identical because the membrane does not feel the cargo) the contrast is 2.0-2.3 at t=40 and 1.1 by t=400. At 1.5x resolution 60 bodies keep >= 6.7x through 19 splits.

claims.statement: In all three seeds, micelles that form from white noise grow on the amphiphile feed and divide repeatedly (18-26 persistent splits, generation 2-3, merge/split <= 0.03), and every micelle, parents and daughters alike, holds the cargo its own amphiphile makes at >= 7x the outside concentration in every recorded frame; removing the partitioning (chi=0) leaves the same bodies and divisions but no contrast (1.1x).
claims.track: seed 1, the micelle in row 3 of fission_strips_seed1.png (t=348-392): formed from noise, holds cargo at ~1150x, elongates and divides into two daughters at ~400x each that stay separate

controls_run.W: pack_chi0/ (seeds 0, 1: chi=0, identical bodies and divisions, contrast 1.1x at t=400, cargo_contrast.txt) and pack_res15/ (1.5x finer grid: every body >= 6.7x, 19 persistent splits)

claims.bd_control: not run; the chi=0 arm is the matched control for containment (cargo moving by plain diffusion through identical bodies).

limits: Containment is equilibrium partitioning of the cargo into the amphiphile core (a potential chi u), not a boundary layer: these bodies are L2, no B is claimed. The cargo is passive (osm=0): it does not affect growth or division, so inheritance of the cargo is automatic once it partitions, and nothing is selected. Division is driven by the global amphiphile feed (open system) and comes in synchronized waves; micelle number grows roughly linearly with the fed amphiphile.
